name: This Is Where I'd Put My Trophy If I Had One
look: Two stacked cartoon panels. Top: Timmy Turner's dad, grinning widely in a white shirt and black tie, gestures toward an empty white pedestal behind red velvet ropes under three spotlights. Bottom: in the same spot he hunches over, clenching his teeth and clawing his hands in bitter frustration.
use: Someone proudly shows off the place reserved for an achievement or possession, then bitterly admits they don't have it. The top line sets up the boast and the bottom line delivers the angry "if I had one" twist.
slots: top panel: 'This is where I'd put my...' and the thing he lacks
bottom panel: the bitter punchline, usually 'IF I HAD ONE!'
examples: This is where I'd put my weekend plans
This is where I'd keep my savings
describe: cartoon dad showing off an empty trophy stand
man proudly points at an empty pedestal then gets bitter
empty display podium with velvet ropes and spotlights
guy smiling at empty trophy spot then clenching teeth angrily
fairly oddparents dad presenting nothing on a pedestal
origin: From the Nickelodeon cartoon The Fairly OddParents, where Timmy's dad shows off the spot for a trophy he never won.
